name: MEPHITIS PUTORIUS
key_symptoms: Sudden contraction of glottis, when drinking or talking. Food goes down wrong way. False croup; cannot exhale. Spasmodic and whooping-cough. Few paroxysms in day-time, but many at night; with vomiting after eating. Asthma, as if inhaling sulphur; cough from talking; hollow, deep, with rawness, hoarseness, and pains through chest. Violent spasmodic cough; worse at night.

mind_symptoms: Excited, full of fancies. Can neither sleep nor work.
head_symptoms: Pain from overexertion; blur; unable to distinguish letters; conjunctiva red; eyes hot and painful.
